package.author: stixez
package.description: Keep game mods, saves and addons in sync between friends' PCs, over LAN or the internet.

en-US.author: stixez
en-US.description: Keep game mods, saves and addons in sync between friends' PCs, over LAN or the internet.
en-US.longDescription: SyncCrate makes every PC in a group match the host's mods, saves and addons, copying only the files that differ. Works over LAN without internet, or from anywhere with a join code. Supports 129 games, including The Sims 4, Minecraft, Valheim and Stardew Valley.
en-US.name: SyncCrate
